description: The AE dataset's row layout — the one declaration. The worker imports it to order every row it writes; `locus ae` reads this same file to serve the layout back to readers. Keys are the AE SQL columns themselves, 1-based: blobs["5"] = origin means SELECT blob5. blobs 1-7 are uniform on every row; from 8 onward each metric's own blobs run contiguously, declared per metric under metrics.*, and a row ends where its metric's own blobs end. Field semantics, validation, and the clock law live in store/src/telemetry.js. blob_domains states each closed value set as the worker writes it.

blobs.8+: the metric's own blobs (metrics.*.blobs), contiguous from 8

cost_sample.note: keyed by the slice the page opened on — a page's later slices carry no cost rows of their own. main_thread_ms is cumulative elapsed time across the recorder's synchronous brackets; read it as the delta between a page's consecutive samples against their ts gap — a delta that fills its wall gap is the process suspended mid-bracket, not work
